# Buffalo.Accountants

> Buffalo.Accountants provides outsourced property accounting, controller, and fractional CFO services for commercial and multifamily real estate portfolios. Headquartered in Buffalo, NY, serving property portfolios nationwide.

Buffalo.Accountants works with multifamily operators, asset managers, property managers, and commercial owners (office, retail, industrial, and multifamily). The firm works inside the platform a client already uses: AppFolio, Yardi Voyager, Yardi Breeze, MRI Software, QuickBooks, or Sage.

Core property accounting is billed as a fixed monthly fee; specialized work is billed hourly or by project. New clients start with a free needs assessment, followed by a fixed-fee proposal and a structured onboarding (chart of accounts, opening balances, and a month-end close calendar).

- Email: info@buffalo.accountants
- Phone: +1-888-801-6424

## Pages

- [Home](https://buffalo.accountants/): Overview of the firm, who it serves, and the platforms it works in
- [Services](https://buffalo.accountants/services): Full menu of services, grouped into three engagement types
- [Contact](https://buffalo.accountants/contact): Schedule a free needs assessment, what to have ready, and FAQs on pricing and onboarding

## Services

- [Core Property Accounting](https://buffalo.accountants/services): Fixed monthly fee. Accounts payable, accounts receivable and tenant billing, bank reconciliations, 3-way trust account reconciliation, security deposit administration, management fee billing, owner distributions, financial statement preparation, and GL maintenance.
- [Specialized Services](https://buffalo.accountants/services): Hourly or project-based. 1099 preparation and filing, CAM reconciliations, utility billback/RUBS, property and portfolio onboarding, acquisition and disposition due diligence, budgets and reforecasts, fixed asset and capex tracking, COI compliance tracking, and sales/rental tax compliance.
- [Controller & Advisory](https://buffalo.accountants/services): Fractional CFO. Interim or outsourced controller, KPI and owner dashboard reporting, 13-week cash flow forecasting, lender compliance reporting, debt schedule and covenant monitoring, month-end close design, SOPs and segregation of duties, year-end audit prep and CPA liaison, and PM software optimization.
